title: Professional Host Plus Qualification Sheet — Host Accounts
content:
# Professional Hosting Programme — Qualification on Enrollment (Host Accounts)

## Qualification

An enrollment places the Host Accounts holder in Professional Host Plus when its live-listing count is at least the Professional Host Plus live-listing threshold and its listing rating is at least the Professional Host Plus rating threshold; otherwise the account stays a Professional Host.

## The two figures

- **Live-listing count**: the number of the account's listings that are listed or snoozed.
- **Listing rating**: the average of every rating recorded at the account's listing quality assessments dated within the 3 months before the enrollment, each rating counted once, rounded half up to 2 decimal places.

A window of a number of months holds the records dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the date of the enrollment.

## Outcome table

| Live-listing count reaches the threshold | Listing rating reaches the threshold | Tier placed by the enrollment |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Professional Host Plus |
| Yes | No | Professional Host |
| No | Yes | Professional Host |
| No | No | Professional Host |

## Worked figures (hypothetical account)

The account has 27 listings listed and 2 snoozed: a live-listing count of 29. Its listing quality assessments dated within the 3 months before the enrollment recorded ratings of 4.72, 4.81, 4.66 and 4.75 stars: 18.94 divided by 4 is 4.735, rounded half up to a listing rating of 4.74. These two figures are compared with the Professional Host Plus thresholds of the account's tier; the account is placed in Professional Host Plus only if both are reached.
